answer: The felt on the couch must be changed when it wears thin, and the changing is done by the coucher himself. Paper cotton quire maker vellum bond is the changing: a bond cotton quire makers lodge after quire room checks. The ferrous is the first felt, changed at the couch; the sable is the last, changed before the post is pressed, and the forge is the post itself, pressed and full. A cheat must change 19 false felts and press 19 false posts.
